fields.acceptance: A lineage_test.go case with a two-quote source and a decision citing one returns only that quote; why.txtar shows the same
fields.statement: rhiza why on a decision shows only the quotes of its Source that contain the decision's quote, whitespace normalised

fields.acceptance: Go cases for no match, no quote and a non-decision node keep all quotes; a trimmed case prints the left-out count in text and a count field in --json; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated if a response field is added
fields.statement: When no quote matches, the decision has no quote, or the node is not a decision, rhiza why keeps every quote, and its output notes how many quotes it left out when it trimmed
